title: Add text length limits to Reader 7 endpoints (SEC-001)
description: All 7 Reader endpoints accept arbitrary-length text with no size check. Add validateStringLength guards for novelId (max 256), text content (max 100000), and name fields (max 200). Return 413 on overflow.
action: In src-ts/reader/mcp/reader-endpoints.ts, import { validateStringLength } from '../../mcp/input-validation.js'. Add validateStringLength guards to 7 endpoints: rsSimulateEndpoint (novelId<=256, text<=100000), rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint (name<=200), rsGetFeedbackEndpoint (novelId<=256), rsGetOverlayEndpoint (novelId<=256), rsCompareEndpoint (novelId<=256, versionA.text<=100000, versionB.text<=100000), rsDetectAIFlavorEndpoint (text<=100000), rsGetPersonaEndpoint (id<=256). Each guard: const err = validateStringLength(value, MAX, 'fieldName'); if (err) return err;

criteria: src-ts/reader/mcp/reader-endpoints.ts contains '413' in at least one error response path
convergence.definition_of_done: All 7 Reader endpoints have length guards that return 413 on oversized input

files.change: Add validateStringLength guards to 7 endpoints for novelId, text, and name fields

implementation: Add constants at top: const MAX_NOVEL_ID_LENGTH = 256; const MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 100_000; const MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 200;

In rsSimulateEndpoint: after extracting novelId and text, add const err = validateStringLength(novelId, MAX_NOVEL_ID_LENGTH, 'novelId'); if (err) return err; and validateStringLength(text, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH, 'text'); if (err) return err;
In rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint: add validateStringLength(name, MAX_NAME_LENGTH, 'name') guard after name extraction
In rsGetFeedbackEndpoint: add validateStringLength(novelId, MAX_NOVEL_ID_LENGTH, 'novelId') guard
In rsGetOverlayEndpoint: add validateStringLength(novelId, MAX_NOVEL_ID_LENGTH, 'novelId') guard
In rsCompareEndpoint: add validateStringLength for novelId, versionA.text, versionB.text
In rsDetectAIFlavorEndpoint: add validateStringLength(text, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH, 'text') guard
In rsGetPersonaEndpoint: add validateStringLength(id, MAX_NOVEL_ID_LENGTH, 'id') guard (reuses MAX_NOVEL_ID_LENGTH for ID fields)

reference.pattern: chat.ts validateChatMessagesLimits — early-return guard pattern with jsonResponse

rationale.chosen_approach: Import shared validateStringLength from input-validation.ts rather than inlining checks; constants at file top for easy tuning; 413 status code per HTTP spec for payload too large

risks.risk: Existing legitimate requests with text near 100k may be rejected
risks.mitigation: 100k is generous for narrative text input; unlikely to break real usage. Can raise if needed.
